aggregation: Average feed-like replicates within match, matches within provider, then report each provider; counts/rates are descriptive cell-level averages.
official_matcher: Global IoU-descending greedy one-to-one assignment at IoU 0.5 over all candidate/reference spells, with subgroup filtering afterward.

interpretation.mechanism_partition: Exclusive diagnostics for globally unmatched complete under-three-second references. The four buckets separate cost-3 suppression, surviving-but-insufficient local evidence, no local team evidence and official assignment conflicts.
interpretation.raw_argmax: A retrospective diagnostic counterfactual over saved native probabilities. It is not a trained or selected prediction and does not estimate deployable gain.
interpretation.oracle: No reference-informed prediction, timing repair or oracle upper bound was computed.
interpretation.evidence: Per-reference probabilities and timing are summarized within aggregate mechanism buckets; no reference rows or frame predictions are emitted.

limitations: Every evaluation match has prior development exposure; results are descriptive and do not establish transfer.
Metrica and SkillCorner references are event-derived silver labels; boundary censoring can affect spell timing.
The raw argmax path is a diagnostic counterfactual and is not a deployable alternative.
No reference-informed repair or oracle prediction is computed.
